scientific_role: fresh disjoint confirmation of provider/evidence-aware automatic country framing plus conditional frozen robust validity; does not alter the validated Japanese product
freeze_sequence: stage1: freeze 48 taxon identities from fixed Japanese discovery-region species facets after all exclusions; no focal historical-country query
stage2: for exactly those 48 frozen identities, fetch historical 1900-2020 country facets once per taxon and freeze an availability-aware country plan
stage3: for each READY country frame, freeze country geometry and execute the unchanged robust candidate generator before heldout opening; classify every taxon into an availability state
stage4: pin all identity/country/availability/candidate artifacts and fingerprints
stage5: only after stages1-4 are complete, open 2021-2025 heldout records and evaluate conditional robust lift

automatic_country_frame.country_rule: among provider-supported countries with historical count >= 5, choose descending historical count; stable SHA256 tie-break only for equal counts

availability_states.PROVIDER_BLOCKED: no supported automatic country frame after historical-only planning
availability_states.SENTINEL_OR_ABSTAIN: outer frame exists but historical/terrain evidence is insufficient to construct the frozen robust core; no fallback prediction is invented
availability_states.ROBUST_EMPTY: frozen robust construction is valid but produces zero candidate patches; retain as a legitimate empty robust output
availability_states.ROBUST_READY_EVALUABLE: robust output frozen before heldout and later heldout is available
availability_states.ROBUST_READY_NOT_RETROSPECTIVELY_EVALUAB: robust output frozen but no qualifying 2021-2025 heldout exists

retrospective_evaluability.definition: ROBUST_READY_EVALUABLE / all robust-constructible taxa; ROBUST_EMPTY with heldout counts as evaluable

overall_pass: all availability, conditional retrospective-evaluability, and conditional predictive-validity gates must pass; classification coverage alone is not promotion

decision.if_pass: promote only the tested automatic provider/evidence-aware global adapter boundary; explicit user-target countries retain fail-closed no-substitution behavior
decision.if_fail: remain development-only; no same-cohort threshold, country-rule, taxon, or method retuning
